name: bifrost-ci-tools
description: Pinned CI-only CLI tooling (newman). Not published, not part of the product build. Installed with `npm ci` so package-lock.json's integrity hashes are enforced, which is what OpenSSF Scorecard's Pinned-Dependencies check requires; a bare `npm install -g newman@x` pins the version but verifies nothing. The overrides block pins transitive deps with known CVEs to patched releases: Dependabot cannot do it (its security updates only touch direct dependencies, and newman-reporter-htmlextra's ranges cap handlebars at 4.7.7), and `npm audit` does not flag them either, so a sync that drops this block is only visible in GitHub's Dependabot alerts. Re-apply it after any sync that touches this directory.
